newsitem.title: USA: CSX, Norfolk Southern complete Conrail merger.
newsitem.headline: CSX, Norfolk Southern complete Conrail merger.

text.p: CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp said Tuesday a jointly controlled company has been merged with Conrail Inc, effective June 2.
Pursuant to the merger, all Conrail shares not owned by CSX, Norfolk Southern or Conrail were converted into the right to receive $115 cash per share, and the remaining Conrail shares were cancelled.

CSX and Norfolk Southern said they indirectly own all the shares of the surviving corporation, named Conrail Inc, which will be held in a joint voting trust pending federal regulatory approval of their acquisition.
